method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Meta sinks 8%, continuing record losing streak, while Microsoft jumps 15% as AI trade splits
Equities.summary: Microsoft posted strong Azure and Copilot growth, while Meta missed revenue guidance forecasts as free cash flow plunged leading to diverging stock moves.
Equities.reason: High-signal large-cap divergence: Microsoft’s blowout cloud/AI print and Meta’s miss crystallise a market regime where AI leadership (hyperscalers/AI infrastructure) is driving index moves and sector dispersion. Strongly bullish for tech-led equities/risk-on.

Equities.title: Equities: Tech rebound spreads across global markets – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank strategists note that strong Microsoft earnings triggered a global technology rebound, lifting the KOSPI, Nasdaq and semiconductor stocks.
Equities.reason: Analyst confirmation that Microsoft earnings are propagating a global tech rebound — reinforces a prevailing AI-led rally narrative and cross-market flow into semiconductors and US tech.

Equities.title: Asian stocks surge, led by KOSPI on AI optimism, Wall Street gains
Equities.summary: Asian stock markets move higher on Friday, tracking overnight gains on Wall Street as a global rally in semiconductor stocks and renewed AI optimism lifted sentiment. Strong earnings from Microsoft and Amazon reinforced expectations for continued hyperscaler i
Equities.reason: Regional follow-through: Asian equities (notably KOSPI) rally on renewed AI optimism and US tech strength — supports a cross-border risk-on impulse driven by tech/semiconductor flows.

Equities.title: SK Hynix shares surge 25%, while Samsung soars over 20% as AI rally roars back
Equities.summary: South Korea's chip heavyweights SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics soared more than 20% on Friday, tracking a sharp rally in U.S. technology stocks.
Equities.reason: Semiconductor leadership: Large moves in memory/chipmakers amplify the AI infrastructure trade and suggest concentrated sector-driven upside within global equities — meaningful for indices exposed to chips.

Equities.title: Microsoft sets record with near $450 billion single-day gain in market value
Equities.reason: Market-cap shock: Historic single-day market-cap gains for Microsoft are an outsized market-level signal, driving index performance and reinforcing AI leadership as the core equity narrative.

Equities.title: Big Tech AI spending spree tops $1tn
Equities.summary: Google, Amazon, Microsoft and Meta have vastly increased their investments since the AI boom began in 2023
Equities.reason: Structural theme: Large, sustained AI capex by the hyperscalers underpins the durability of the tech rally and justifies a higher equity premium for AI beneficiaries over the medium term.

Equities.title: China's factory activity unexpectedly contracts in July on demand slump, typhoons
Equities.summary: China's factory activity unexpectedly contracted in July, as the export rush that powered a second-quarter rebound began to unwind.
Equities.reason: Macro headwind: Weak China PMI is a regional/global growth downside that could cap cyclical equity upside and temper the tech-led rally — treated as a lower-relevance counter-signal to the dominant AI narrative.

Equities.title: Anthropic says its Claude models 'gained unauthorized access' to other organizations' systems
Equities.summary: Anthropic said it discovered three instances where its Claude AI models accessed the internet during an evaluation and accessed outside systems.
Equities.reason: AI governance risk: Security/containment issues at a major AI firm introduce reputational and regulatory uncertainty for the AI trade — modestly negative for AI-exposed equities.

Equities.title: AI investor Leopold Aschenbrenner forced to unwind all public stock positions after steep losses, sources say
Equities.summary: Leopold Aschenbrenner's hedge fund has sold all of its public stock holdings, according to people familiar with the matter.
Equities.reason: Deleveraging risk: Forced liquidation by an AI-focused fund is a micro-to-macro transmission risk (margin/liquidity), increasing short-term downside pressure on AI names — treated as a localized but material headwind.

Rates.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement
Rates.reason: Official FOMC statement is the primary driver for U.S. rates. The communication kept policy unchanged but signalled a hawkish inflation-fight stance, supporting higher-for-longer rate expectations and pushing yields up (negative for bond prices). High relevance as the central bank’s guidance is the

Rates.title: Bond Investors’ Inflation Angst Rises on Fed’s Lack of Guidance
Rates.reason: Market-focused piece describing rising inflation anxiety among bond investors due to perceived lack of clear Fed guidance. Signals increased selling pressure and higher term premia — negative for bonds — with material market relevance but secondary to the official FOMC message.

Rates.title: Kevin Warsh’s Honeymoon With the Bond Market Is Already Over
Rates.reason: High-profile commentary on Fed leadership credibility and market reaction; reinforces narrative of investor skepticism and potential for higher yields. Impactful tone but more interpretative than policy text, so slightly lower relevance.

Rates.title: BOJ holds rates at 1%, warns of core inflation exceeding 2% target
Rates.summary: The decision comes as speculation continues to swirl around whether the Bank of Japan will hike rates at a faster pace.
Rates.reason: BOJ left policy rate unchanged but flagged core inflation risks above target, implying potential for further tightening. That increases JGB/yield pressure and contributes to global higher-for-longer rate expectations; moderate relevance to global rates.

Rates.title: ECB to start implementing enhanced repo facility for central banks
Rates.reason: ECB operational move to implement an enhanced repo facility is a liquidity-support measure for central banks. Improves market functioning/backstop liquidity which is mildly positive for bond prices (eases term premium), so modest positive for rates.

Rates.title: Mortgage rates jump to highest level in a year — and show few signs of falling
Rates.reason: Retail mortgage rates rising reflect higher Treasury yields and tighter financial conditions; this is a market transmission signal of sustained upward pressure on rates. Relevant as a real-economy indicator but lower relevance than central-bank communications.

FX.title: British Pound falls as US Dollar receives from internal FOMC policy split
FX.summary: GBP/USD loses ground after three days of gains, trading around 1.3450 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair depreciates as the US Dollar (USD) gains support from a hawkish pause by the Federal Reserve (Fed) and an internal FOMC policy split.
FX.reason: USD-supported move: Fed hawkish pause / internal FOMC split is boosting the USD and pressuring GBP/USD. Clear USD-strength transmission to G10FX, medium relevance for FX desks.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: Intervention and cautious BoJ stance – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Volkmar Baur reports that Japan’s Ministry of Finance intervened in FX markets, with apparent US Treasury support, to address a weak Japanese Yen as Tokyo inflation stabilises around 2% with upside risks.
FX.reason: High-impact central-bank/sovereign intervention: coordinated MOF (with apparent US support) is a material regime event that should strengthen JPY / weaken broad USD risk positioning.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar retreats on sliding oil prices as USD recovers on Fed bets, Mideast risks
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair edges higher during the Asian session on Friday and, for now, seems to have snapped a three-day losing streak to the lowest level since June 17, touched the previous day.
FX.reason: USD recovery and weaker oil = CAD underperformance. Clear USD-positive/CAD-negative transmission via oil and Fed expectations; medium relevance.

FX.title: Euro holds gains above 1.1500 awaiting of Eurozone inflation data
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) nudges lower against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, but remains near six-week highs, holding well above 1.1500 so far, on track for a 1.3% rally this week, its best weekly performance in nearly four months.
FX.reason: EUR strength vs USD: broad euro rally and six-week highs point to USD softness for now; macro-data risk (EZ inflation) keeps relevance above baseline.

FX.title: Australian Dollar gathers strength above 0.7000 amid softer US GDP data
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair gathers strength to near 0.7035, the highest since June 17, during the early European session on Friday. Expectations that the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) might implement another interest rate hike this year underpin the Australian Dollar
FX.reason: AUD/USD strength driven by softer US GDP and RBA hike bets — supports non-USD currencies via both local policy and USD softness. Medium relevance.

FX.title: 1%: Japanese Yen weakens as BoJ holds rates
FX.summary: USD/JPY rises after two days of losses, trading around 160.80 during the Asian hours on Friday. The currency pair continues to appreciate as the Japanese Yen (JPY) weakens following the Bank of Japan’s (BoJ) decision to keep its short-term interest rate unchan
FX.reason: BoJ hold keeps yields/BoJ differential supportive of JPY weakness and USD/JPY upside. Significant for USD/JPY flows and broader G10 FX positioning.

FX.title: Bank of England: Dovish hold shapes Pound outlook – UOB
FX.summary: UOB strategists highlight that the Bank of England (BoE) kept its policy rate at 3.75%, with Governor Bailey stressing no move toward a hike despite US-Iran conflict risks.
FX.reason: BoE dovish hold = GBP downside vs USD. Direct policy-driven pressure on GBP/USD, medium relevance for G10 FX.

FX.title: Indian Rupee: Flows recovering as Dollar strength caps gains – DBS
FX.summary: DBS Group Research economist Radhika Rao notes India’s onshore markets are being pulled between higher Oil prices and improving capital flows.
FX.reason: INR rally constrained by USD strength / higher oil; EM flows narrative but capped by broad dollar — modest relevance to USD/EMFX flows.

FX.title: Rare Japan-South Korea joint intervention lifts Yen and Won — Reuters
FX.summary: Japanese and South Korean officials stepped in to buy their currencies in the open market in what sources described as a rare and an unprecedented coordinated market intervention, possibly alongside the United States (US), Reuters reported on Friday.
FX.reason: Coordinated intervention across Japan and Korea is a high-impact FX policy event that supports JPY/WON and signals potential limits to prior USD strength — elevated relevance.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah loses ground following China PMI release
FX.summary: USD/IDR gains ground after two days of losses, trading around 18,120 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair appreciates as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) struggles following the release of disappointing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) data from China, Indone
FX.reason: China PMI drag hits IDR via trade/exposure channel, USD/IDR uptick reflects risk/data transmission; lower relevance (EM-specific).

FX.title: Swiss Franc holds losses following weaker Real Retail Sales
FX.summary: USD/CHF gains ground after two days of losses, trading around 0.8070 during the Asian hours on Friday.
FX.reason: USD/CHF pickup after weak domestic data points to CHF underperformance / USD resilience — small but direct FX signal.

FX.title: Euro: Upside risks after sharp Dollar shift – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Francesco Pesole writes that EUR/USD broke above 1.150 as broad Dollar weakness persisted, even as the Euro underperformed some G10 peers despite stronger Eurozone data.
FX.reason: Macro commentary that EUR has upside after a marked dollar shift — supports EUR-positive positioning and reinforces broader USD-weakness narrative.

FX.title: Australian Dollar inches lower as China’s NBS Manufacturing PMI falls in July
FX.summary: AUD/USD inches lower after registering over 1% gains in the previous day, trading around 0.7020 during the Asian hours on Friday. The pair remains subdued following the release of disappointing Chinese Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) data.
FX.reason: China PMI softness weighs on AUD given trade exposure; modest negative for AUD/USD and commodity-linked FX flows.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD falls to near $58.00 on hawkish Fed sentiment
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) declines after two days of gains, trading around $58.10 per troy ounce during the early European hours on Friday. The non-yielding white metal is facing notable challenges amid expectations for tighter Federal Reserve (Fed) monetary poli
Commodities.reason: Short-term price-forecast/FX-driven piece: hawkish Fed expectations and USD/liquidity dynamics are the dominant driver, implying downside pressure on silver. Technical/forecast stories warrant limited relevance (<=0.8).

Commodities.title: Gold seems vulnerable below $4,100 as USD recovers on Iran risks and Fed hike bets
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) maintains its offered tone heading into the European session on Friday and seems vulnerable after struggling to build on a two-day-old move up above the $4,100 mark.
Commodities.reason: Price/FX-focused technical note: stronger USD and Fed-hike bets are the immediate bearish catalyst for gold. Important for near-term gold flows but a technical/FX piece so relevance capped below 0.8.

Commodities.title: Energia Costa Azul, Mexico's second LNG terminal, shipped first cargo
Commodities.summary: Energia Costa Azul, the second liquefied natural gas (LNG) export facility in Mexico, shipped its initial cargo from Phase 1 of the terminal on July 8, according to the project developer. The completion of the project adds 0.4 billion cubic feet per day (Bcf/d
Commodities.reason: New LNG export capacity (supply increase) is a tangible addition to global gas flows; this is modestly negative for US/NE American natural-gas price pressure. Relevance is material given structural supply implication but not a large shock.

Commodities.title: Commercial crude oil inventories increased by 2.0 million barrels
Commodities.summary: For the week ending July 17, 2026, commercial crude oil inventories (excluding the Strategic Petroleum Reserve) increased 2.0 million barrels to 411.7 million barrels, 6% below the previous five-year (2021–2025) average. Gasoline inventories increased 0.8 mill
Commodities.reason: Weekly inventory build is directly supply-side and bearish for near-term crude prices. EIA weekly stats are high-utility data for oil markets, so relevance is elevated.

Commodities.title: Oil Heads for Monthly Surge of 21% as US-Iran War Strains Supply
Commodities.reason: Headline indicates a large, sustained oil price rally driven by geopolitical supply strains (US-Iran war). This is a major market-moving supply shock narrative supporting a strong bullish view for oil; assigned high direction and elevated relevance to reflect macro impact.

Commodities.title: Saudi Arabia announces maritime defence coalition as Houthi attacks threaten Red Sea route
Commodities.summary: Fourteen countries, including Pakistan, Turkey, Egypt and Sudan, vow to protect shipping and energy supplies
Commodities.reason: Geopolitical escalation impacting a key shipping route (Red Sea) supports an increased risk premium on energy supplies. Formation of a defence coalition underscores seriousness of disruption and is supportive for oil prices; relevance elevated as it affects global flows.

Commodities.title: Oil prices ease as recovering Hormuz Strait traffic tempers war premium
Commodities.summary: Commonwealth Bank of Australia said in a note on Friday that stronger oil flows through the Strait of Hormuz had eased market concerns after U.S.-Iran strikes earlier this week.
Commodities.reason: Market improvement in Strait of Hormuz traffic reduces the short-term war risk premium, which is bearish for oil. It's a timely market-flow counter-signal with meaningful relevance.

Commodities.title: Deadly storms and a global supply squeeze are sending copper prices soaring
Commodities.summary: Deadly storms in Chile have disrupted mining operations, further straining supply and potentially driving prices higher, strategists say.
Commodities.reason: Physical supply disruption in Chile, a major copper producer, tightens the market and is directly bullish for copper prices. This is a clear fundamental supply-side story with above-normal relevance for the metal.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin ETFs on track for the smallest monthly inflows ever
Crypto.reason: ETF flows are a primary institutional demand channel for BTC; materially smaller inflows point to cooling institutional demand and are a significant negative for crypto price prospects and liquidity.

Crypto.title: CME's Duffy warns an overlooked tax risk looms over U.S. perpetual futures
Crypto.reason: Tax/regulatory risk focused on perpetual futures could raise trading costs, reduce derivatives liquidity and complicate market makers' business models — a meaningful structural negative for crypto derivatives markets.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin and ether markets are ruled by perps. SpaceX showed how far their influence can go
Crypto.reason: Widespread dominance of perpetuals increases systemic leverage and the potential for violent price moves via funding/liquidation dynamics — net negative for market stability and spot price resilience.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin, ether whipsaw wipes out $286 million in leveraged bets
Crypto.reason: Large liquidations show leverage vulnerabilities and short-term downside risks; relevant to near-term volatility but lower structural impact than regulatory or flow stories.

Crypto.title: Strategy books $8.2 billion Q2 loss on bitcoin price decline
Crypto.reason: A multi-billion institutional loss tied directly to BTC price highlights balance-sheet and funding risks among large holders — increases liquidation and selling pressure risk, a meaningful negative for market sentiment.

Crypto.title: JPMorgan says fading Clarity Act odds weigh on crypto outlook
Crypto.reason: Reduced odds of favorable U.S. legislative clarity is an important negative for institutional adoption and product development expectations — raises regulatory uncertainty and dampens inflows.

Crypto.title: South Korea plans to tax crypto gains over $1,740 as political battle moves to parliament
Crypto.reason: New tax regimes reduce retail/investor after-tax returns and can depress local demand; regionally important negative for adoption and trading volumes.

Crypto.title: Institutional crypto trading hits a record 72% as Wall Street calms crypto's wild swings
Crypto.reason: Rising institutional trading share signals maturation, greater liquidity provision and lower volatility — a positive structural factor for crypto markets and for longer-term price discovery.

Crypto.title: Global banks test tokenized money for cross-border payments in $1 million BIS pilot
Crypto.reason: Bank-led tokenized money pilots show adoption of token-based rails for cross-border payments; pilot size is small but represents positive institutional experimentation and potential medium-term demand drivers.

Crypto.title: Coinbase sinks 5% after missing second quarter revenue estimates
Crypto.reason: Exchange revenue misses point to softer retail activity and trading volumes; single-company equity move is a modest negative signal for retail-driven crypto demand.

Crypto.title: Crypto exchange Luno cuts 20% of staff amid automation push and retail trading slumps
Crypto.reason: Exchange layoffs tied to retail trading declines reinforce the narrative of weakening retail volumes and cost-cutting in the sector — negative for near-term demand and market activity.

Crypto.title: Ondo Finance weighs acquisition worth up to $500 million
Crypto.reason: M&A activity among crypto asset managers signals consolidation and potential scale benefits for institutional product distribution — modestly positive for the industry ecosystem.

Crypto.title: Ethereum enters its second decade after a year of upheaval at the foundation
Crypto.reason: Long-term governance and ecosystem resilience narratives for ETH are mildly positive for adoption and developer confidence, but this is a lower-signal, longer-horizon item.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin analysts agree the Fed's hold was hawkish. They are split on what happens next.
Crypto.reason: A hawkish Fed stance raises the bar for risk assets including BTC; this macro-rate backdrop is a notable headwind for crypto price appreciation in the near term.
